say:7:1421908005:1.text: Hmm... Could this be referring to the legendary Forgemaster Festival?! To show their gratitude for Helthor's blessing, the dwarves would offer their most cherished possessions...

say:10:1421908007:1.text: I think I heard about this ancient festival when I was little... I remember asking the adults why the god would need so much valuable stuff...

say:11:1421908008:1.text: I believe the festival was more about showcasing one's possessions rather than offering them. Once the festival was over, the items would be returned to their owners.
